title: Location.
officialText:
Family or assisted-use toilet and bathing rooms shall be located on an accessible route. Family or assisted-
use toilet rooms shall be located not more than one story above or below separate-sex toilet rooms. The accessible route from any
separate-sex toilet room to a family or assisted-use toilet room shall not exceed 500 feet (152 m).
